summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026 with the SEC, furnishing an ASX public notice dated the same day disclosing positive Phase 1 imaging trial data for RAD301, a Gallium-68 labeled peptide targeting alpha-v-beta-6 integrin, in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The filing reports favorable safety and biodistribution with significant tumor uptake in metastatic lesions across all evaluable patients. No financial or transactional terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine clinical data update for a Nasdaq-listed Australian foreign private issuer.
